8.3.5 LinSM_RequestComMode
[SWS_LinSM_00126] Definition of API function LinSM_RequestComMode
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00369
⌈
Service Name
LinSM_RequestComMode
Syntax
Std_ReturnType LinSM_RequestComMode (
NetworkHandleType network,
ComM_ModeType mode
)
Service ID [hex]
0x40
Sync/Async
Asynchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different networks. Non reentrant for the same network.
network
Handle of the communication network
Parameters (in)
mode
Requested communication mode
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Request accepted
E_NOT_OK: Request not accepted
Description
Request of a new communication mode.
Available via
LinSM.h
